description: Where agents got stuck and what they did about it. A time stuck is a failed tool call and the retries of the same tool straight after it; each ends recovered (the tool then worked, with meanRetries retries on average), wentElsewhere (the agent called something else, insteadMostOften), endedOnIt (the session stopped there, nothing for 30 minutes) or undecided (too recent to tell); looped counts those where a retry repeated the same arguments. Without a tool: every session by the worst that happened in it (clean, recovered, wentElsewhere, looped, endedOnFailure, undecided) and the tools agents got stuck at, worst first. With a tool: that tool's times stuck, as a whole and by client.

client.description: Only calls from this client type, as list_clients names them, such as claude-code or cursor.

days.description: How many days back to look, ending now. 7 when left out. Ignored when from is given.

from.description: Start of the window, as an ISO 8601 date or time. Overrides days.

server.description: The MCP server to ask about, by name or id. Leave out when the account has only one.

to.description: End of the window, as an ISO 8601 date or time. Now when left out.

tool.description: Only this tool, split by client. The tool's name, as list_tools gives it.

name: get_where_agents_get_lost
title: Where agents get lost
